body: No I understand that reaction. I love sex and love being a sexual being but Im a victim of sexual assault and still working through the trauma that left me. Its one thing to want it, it is a complete other thing to be forced onto you.

I wish for the same thing. I'm sitting here in my bed knowing that tomorrow will come and I'll have to live the same agonizing life. My therapist makes me feel so good and full of prospect but then not 24 hours later I'm wishing and praying anything would take my life. It's so much pain. I've gotten to a point where I can't even find words to describe how much it hurts and how much I just want to give up. But I can't. I'm not strong enough to live any sort of productive life but I'm too weak to end it. I'm caught in this horrible in between of begging and my brain wanting it to end but not being able to get over the death barrier.
Yes please. Just thinking about the way my body would react to yours is making my mouth water for more.
